title: Stable blowup for the harmonic map heat flow into perturbed spheres
summary: We prove stable self-similar blowup for the harmonic map heat flow in dimensions 3 to 6 for target manifolds which are slightly perturbed versions of the round sphere. Starting from the known blowup solution for the sphere, we construct self-similar blowup solutions for this class of target manifolds and prove that these solutions are asymptotically nonlinear stable.
